title: Appeals and Grievances Schedule of Filing Terms
content:
Filing terms for **Appeals and Grievances** cases are fixed per case type. The schedule below sets, for each of the six case types, whether a filing deadline applies, its length, the notice whose date starts the filing clock, whether the case may be filed orally, whether an oral filing must be followed by a signed written request, the channels accepted and the fee to file.

## Schedule

| Case type | Filing deadline applies | Deadline (calendar days after the notice date) | Notice that starts the filing clock | Oral filing accepted | Signed written follow-up to an oral filing | Filing channels | Fee to file (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | No | 0 | Not applicable | Yes | Not required | phone, mail, fax, member portal, in person | 0.00 |
| Quality of Care Grievance | No | 0 | Not applicable | Yes | Not required | phone, mail, fax, member portal, in person | 0.00 |
| Standard Appeal | Yes | 60 | The adverse benefit determination notice | Yes | Not required | phone, mail, fax, member portal, in person | 0.00 |
| Expedited Appeal | Yes | 60 | The adverse benefit determination notice | Yes | Not required | phone, mail, fax, member portal, in person | 0.00 |
| State Fair Hearing | Yes | 120 | The plan appeal's resolution notice | Yes | Not required | phone, mail, fax, state hearing portal | 0.00 |
| External Medical Review | Yes | 120 | The plan appeal's resolution notice | Yes | Not required | phone, mail, fax | 0.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Deadline column.** The figure is the number of calendar days after the date on the anchor notice within which the case must be filed. A figure of 0 appears only where no filing deadline applies, that is, for the two grievance types.
2. **Anchor notice.** For a Standard Appeal or an Expedited Appeal the clock runs from the adverse benefit determination notice; for a State Fair Hearing or an External Medical Review it runs from the resolution notice of the plan appeal. A grievance has no anchor notice.
3. **Channels.** The five channels phone, mail, fax, member portal and in person are accepted for both grievance types and both plan appeal types. A State Fair Hearing is accepted by phone, mail, fax or the state hearing portal; an External Medical Review by phone, mail or fax only.
4. **Oral filing and fee.** Every case type may be filed orally, none requires a signed written request after an oral filing, and no case type carries a filing fee.

## Reading a row (hypothetical)

A member who wishes to request an External Medical Review may do so by phone, mail or fax, without charge and without sending a written request after a phone filing; the request falls under a deadline of 120 calendar days counted from the date of the plan appeal's resolution notice. The same member could not use the member portal or attend in person for that case type, since neither channel is listed in its row.
